method: Local ENZ; both first stations translated to zero. No rotation, scale, fitted shift or GNSS. Main chains only. Samples at 1001 equal fractions of each 3D chain length, endpoints included. Correlations are descriptive, samples are not independent observations.
limitations: Raw recorded axes: date, fix, declination and network corrections ignored.
Common origin is a drawing assumption, not a physical tie.
Shape correlation partly reflects the dominant direction; samples are dependent.
Nearest-segment matches do not establish physical station identity or monotone correspondence.
Kujat baseline retains four unresolved readings.
